units.rawText: Who's the interloper that dares trespass upon my dungeon... Eh? Professor?
units.displayText: Who's the interloper that dares trespass upon my dungeon... Eh? Professor?

spans.text: Who's the interloper that dares trespass upon my dungeon... Eh? Professor?

units.rawText: Er, Nascita? No, wait, from the way you're dressed... Are you Dark Warrior N?
units.displayText: Er, Nascita? No, wait, from the way you're dressed... Are you Dark Warrior N?

spans.text: Er, Nascita? No, wait, from the way you're dressed... Are you Dark Warrior N?

units.rawText: (Didn't Anna say that this roleplay dungeon wasn't open yet? How did the Professor get in here...)
units.displayText: Didn't Anna say that this roleplay dungeon wasn't open yet? How did the Professor get in here...

spans.text: Didn't Anna say that this roleplay dungeon wasn't open yet? How did the Professor get in here...

units.rawText: (What should I do... I'm still rehearsing my lines. I can't reveal my true identity, no matter what... Looks like this is my only choice!)
units.displayText: What should I do... I'm still rehearsing my lines. I can't reveal my true identity, no matter what... Looks like this is my only choice!

spans.text: What should I do... I'm still rehearsing my lines. I can't reveal my true identity, no matter what... Looks like this is my only choice!

units.rawText: Ahem! Who are you calling Nascita? I am the great and mighty Dungeon Master N! Did you not barge in here because you coveted my dungeon's wealth?
units.displayText: Ahem! Who are you calling Nascita? I am the great and mighty Dungeon Master N! Did you not barge in here because you coveted my dungeon's wealth?

spans.text: Ahem! Who are you calling Nascita? I am the great and mighty Dungeon Master N! Did you not barge in here because you coveted my dungeon's wealth?

units.rawText: An array of glittering prizes is scattered through the area.
units.displayText: An array of glittering prizes is scattered through the area.

spans.text: An array of glittering prizes is scattered through the area.

units.rawText: <size=28>Is that her character this time... Let's play along, then.</size> Indeed, I have come to seize your treasure!
units.displayText: Is that her character this time... Let's play along, then. Indeed, I have come to seize your treasure!

spans.text: Is that her character this time... Let's play along, then.
Indeed, I have come to seize your treasure!

units.rawText: I will never let you get your way.
units.displayText: I will never let you get your way.

spans.text: I will never let you get your way.

units.rawText: Go forth, my minion! Banish them from this place!
units.displayText: Go forth, my minion! Banish them from this place!

spans.text: Go forth, my minion! Banish them from this place!
Banish? Minion?

units.rawText: Hehehe, fall before the speed of my minion! <color=orange>For every step you take, they'll take two!</color> You'll never escape them.
units.displayText: Hehehe, fall before the speed of my minion! For every step you take, they'll take two! You'll never escape them.

spans.text: Hehehe, fall before the speed of my minion!
For every step you take, they'll take two!
You'll never escape them.

units.rawText: Still, be at ease, for I am merciful and do not wish to take your life. If my minion <color=orange>touches</color> you, you will be ejected from this domain.
units.displayText: Still, be at ease, for I am merciful and do not wish to take your life. If my minion touches you, you will be ejected from this domain.

spans.text: Still, be at ease, for I am merciful and do not wish to take your life. If my minion
touches
you, you will be ejected from this domain.

units.rawText: So you're saying <color=orange>I need to run and hide while collecting the rewards, then?</color> Looks like there are a lot of mechanisms in this area that I can use.
units.displayText: So you're saying I need to run and hide while collecting the rewards, then? Looks like there are a lot of mechanisms in this area that I can use.

I need to run and hide while collecting the rewards, then?

units.rawText: Very well, Dungeon Master N. Let's see if your minion can catch us first before we can empty out this dungeon.
units.displayText: Very well, Dungeon Master N. Let's see if your minion can catch us first before we can empty out this dungeon.
